ModMetaData.name: Honor, Not Luxury
ModMetaData.author: 叮咚 / DingDong
ModMetaData.description:
让贵族头衔代表荣誉，而不必强制过上奢侈生活。 分别调整爵位的卧室、日常谒见厅、服装款式与品质、食物、期望和工作限制。可选择保持原有机制、仅正式殖民者免除或所有角色免除。 保留爵位权益和授勋仪式的谒见厅要求。需要 Royalty 和 Harmony；支持简体中文与英语。 源于叮咚的个人需求，代码由 AI 编写，叮咚审阅并游戏内测试，分享给有同样需求的玩家。
Keep royal honor without having to live in luxury. Independently adjust title requirements for bedrooms, daily throne rooms, apparel style and quality, food, expectations, and work. Keep existing rules, exempt permanent colonists, or exempt everyone. Title benefits and bestowing throne-room requirements remain. Requires Royalty and Harmony; supports English and Simplified Chinese. Based on DingDong's personal needs. Code written by AI, reviewed and tested in game by DingDong, and shared with players who want the same choice.
